sample_panel.balance: Thirty prompts per count and ten counts per seed.
sample_panel.inference_label: The seed-disjoint registered confirmation split is reported first, followed by full-panel coverage. Earlier parser/site/behavior smokes may have touched individual prompts, so the split is registered confirmation rather than pristine held-out.

development_selection.nested_membership_audit: PASS: every smaller bank is an exact prefix subset of each larger bank.

superseded_all_seed_bank_audit.interpretation: The strict split changes four K125 members; only the discovery-only bank is used below.

development_selection.plan_label: Head ranking uses only discovery seeds 1234-1253. The same fixed bank is applied to both the discovery and seed-disjoint registered-confirmation cohorts; pooled full-panel coverage is reported separately from confirmation inference.

anchor_registry.algorithm_rule: Deterministically minimize prior grammar, surface, and transition-index use; all K and arms reuse the same registry.
anchor_registry.sample_flow_rule: All 300 prompts remain in the denominator table; prompts without a locally eligible k-to-k+1 transition are marked not applicable rather than silently dropped.

intervention.selected_arm: Zero K frozen pre-O head slices at the routed query and every later cached decode forward.
intervention.random_control: Three distinct selected-excluded banks with exactly matched selected-head counts per layer.
intervention.endpoint: The first semantic generated city record equals the parser-registered next prompt needle.

execution_matrix.K125: All 300 prompt units: shared clean, selected bank, and three layer-matched random repeats on every eligible registered anchor.
execution_matrix.K32_K112: Registered-confirmation seeds 1254-1263 only: selected bank and three layer-matched random repeats; reuse the identical K125 clean endpoint by prompt-anchor key.

abandoned_pilot_exclusion.reason: Stopped because secondary K doses belong on the registered-confirmation split; this wrong-scope all-panel pilot is excluded by path from every registered analysis.

estimands.confirmation_primary_all_examples: On seeds 1254-1263, selected failure minus mean random failure on paired transitions.
estimands.confirmation_secondary_clean_correct: The same contrast among transitions retrieved correctly by clean generation.
estimands.full_panel_coverage: Repeat both estimands on all seeds 1234-1263 and label them development-conditioned full-panel estimates.
estimands.dose_response: On registered-confirmation seeds 1254-1263, pooled seed-level contrasts over K32, K64, K80, K96, K112, and K125; secondary K values reuse the K125 clean arm.
estimands.grammar_specific_k125: Per-primary-grammar estimates plus natural-frequency pooled and equal-grammar-weight macro summaries.

inference.hierarchy: At most one selected transition per seed-count prompt; average counts within seed, then weight seeds equally.
inference.bootstrap: Nonparametric seed-cluster bootstrap with 10000 deterministic draws.
inference.test: Two-sided seed-level sign-flip when at least ten seeds support an estimand.
inference.multiplicity: Holm correction across six pooled K tests per endpoint and separately across four K125 primary-grammar tests per endpoint.
inference.small_support_rule: Fewer than ten supporting seeds is descriptive/exploratory.

shared_with_non_thinking: raw ranked and raw random arms before contrast
exact sample flow and hash audit

no_reselection_rule: K values, head membership, routing, anchor registry, controls, endpoint, sample hierarchy, and estimands are frozen for the full-panel sweep.
